name: Valeria Cortez Vaca Diez
headline: Lead Data Scientist at Monzo Bank 🚀
summary:
With a robust background in data science and financial crime prevention, my expertise at Monzo Bank is centered around harnessing the power of data and AI to safeguard our systems. The team and I strive to advance anti-money laundering initiatives, aligning our mission with the bank's values of innovation and security. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our continuous pursuit of strategic data solutions that bolster operational compliance and efficiency.

In my most recent role, I have led the development of sophisticated data and analytics pipelines, which play a crucial role in enhancing the quality and efficiency of financial crime controls. These initiatives have demonstrated our ability to monitor and detect financial crime activities, ensuring Monzo Bank remains at the forefront of technological advancements in the financial sector.

positions.title: Lead Data Scientist, Financial Crime
positions.description:
- Developed and implemented strategic data plans to detect and prevent financial crime, collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance anti-money laundering initiatives.

- Led the creation of advanced data and analytics pipelines, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and improving operational readiness.

- Conducted proof-of-concept projects utilising generative AI technologies to elevate the quality and efficiency of financial crime investigations.

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist, Financial Crime
positions.description:
- Designed and deployed machine learning models to detect and monitor financial crime activities, processing large-scale transactional data of our 10M+ retail customers and 500k business clients.

- Established robust monitoring frameworks for financial crime detection models, ensuring consistent performance and timely identification of potential issues.

- Conducted controlled experiments to evaluate and optimise machine learning models and fincrime rules, enhancing the effectiveness of anti-money laundering initiatives.

positions.title: Senior Decision Scientist, Borrowing
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented predictive models for loan and overdraft products, contributing to a significant growth in the borrowing portfolio to £259M.

- Analysed data and established robust monitoring systems to assess the impact of significant events such as COVID-19 and cost of life crises, enabling informed decision-making for risk management.

- Supported the growth team to boost marketing campaigns effectiveness up to 200% by building a multi objective optimisation using uplift models.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Led research and development of auditing mechanisms to assess "fairness" in machine learning models.  
- Developed a time-series forecasting model using FBProphet for the largest call centre in the UK.

positions.title: Project Manager / Data Scientist (MSc placement)
positions.description:
Data Spark is a joint initiative between Imperial Business Analytics Research Centre and KPMG for the use of Big data analytics to answer complex business problems.

Received award by Imperial College for "outstanding individual contribution in project management".

- Managed a team of 5 students working as consultants for the organisation ProMed
- Planned interaction with client and mentors
- Applied descriptive and predictive modelling techniques (Probit regression, Random Forest and LogitBoost) and performed network analysis 
- Visualised results using Tableau and NetworkX

Blog here: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/business-school/department-news/imperial-business-analytics-projects/data-spark/data-spark-thought-leadership-article-modelling-conditional-probability-of-re-emerging-infectious-diseases/

positions.title: Senior Product Development Manager

- Designed and Implemented an interactive dashboard to analyse and report key product KPIs using Python, Django, Angular and ChartJS to the CEO, company board and its investors

- Led product development; researched and prioritised customer’s requirements for three technical teams to build and improve TAB’s analytics dashboard and Eikon app at Thomson Reuters

- Developed several working prototypes, conducted UX tests and designed UIs to optimise TAB’s user experience

positions.title: Manager of Business and Product Development
positions.description:
- Coordinated re-design of TAB’s analytics dashboard together with sales and technical team to target different customer segments efficiently; launched process for product development.

- Negotiated integration of  crowdfunding and P2P lending platforms’ data; managed relationships with platforms and associations.

- Managed data collection and analysis of 500+ platforms for a report commissioned by the European Commission to evaluate impact on regulatory events on market volumes.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
